//: Generation sets for tools/codegen/types.ts. One set = upstream files generated (and resolved) together.
class: structs emitted as `class` (constructor takes all fields in declaration order); methods are added
by the hand port via `declare module` + prototype assignment (PORTING.md section 5).
hand: types whose definition is hand-written in the mirrored hand-port module; only re-exported (+ Debug if derived).
discriminant: fieldless enums that also get `<Enum>_discriminant` without explicit discriminants.
skip: types not generated at all (reported).
Names may be bare (`Token`) or module-qualified (`rustc_lexer::Token`).
auto_class: structs with an inherent impl (with fns) anywhere in the set are emitted as class too.
